hub.speaker: Zevara
hub.text: Watch Captain Zevara. Report or complaint, give me the short version. I've been on since before the gate opened and I'll be on after it shuts.

text_variants.text: Word travels. You've been taking lessons from the Guild-square [Necromancer]. Legal. It went in a file anyway. Two pages so far. Attendance and dates.
text_variants._comment: Authored FIRST deliberately: last-match-wins, so quest/closure greetings override the standing cold line.

text_variants.text: The gate doesn't close at dusk and neither do I. Say your business and let one of us get some sleep eventually.
The thing under the market. I hear it's handled. Good. I sleep worse than you'd think over not knowing what's beneath my own streets. However you settled it, the Watch owes you a quiet night.
Still here? The hole in the ground isn't getting shallower. Take Olesm's map and take the spearmaster, and go find out what dug tunnels under my city.

The one who went down the tunnels and climbed back out. The gallery's bricked and the streets are quiet. There's a report on my desk with your name in it, and I signed it this time. Rest. You've earned a boring week.

options.text: I need the Watch to sweep the cisterns under the market.
options._comment: GH#334 ruling 8 (H1): hide_when is an AND; one key, not two.

options.text: You sent a runner for me?
It's done. The thing under the city won't be climbing up.
I heard you can breathe fire.
Why'd you take this job? It's eating you.
Remind me what's happening with the cisterns?

zevara_oldblood.speaker: Zevara
zevara_oldblood.text: Oldblood, yes. Fire, technically. Ten seconds of it, no air in my lungs the whole time, and a day of sounding like a gravel cart after. It's a weapon you pay for using, so I file it where I file all last resorts. You want fire that works, requisition a mage.

zevara_oath.speaker: Zevara
zevara_oath.text: Somebody before me let things slide. Reports that went nowhere, as long as the dead were the kind the city didn't mourn. I wrote it up. Command found the paperwork inconvenient and the facts worse — and then the chair was mine. So no, I don't sleep much. The old reports are still in the cabinet behind my desk. Archiving them is a one-line requisition. I haven't written it.

options.text: The city's lucky it was you.

zevara_oath_two.speaker: Zevara
zevara_oath_two.text: Ten years of overtime is what that was. But — thank you. File it under 'said once.' Now get out of my gatehouse before I find you a shift.

zevara_bounties.speaker: Zevara
zevara_bounties.text: Good. The Watch posts standing bounties on anything that made a file cross my desk. You clear it and claim it here. I sign it. Keep the receipts honest. The Council audits the ledger every month.

options.text: The scavengers off Market Street are dealt with.
The cistern nest is gone. You know that one firsthand.
The thing under the city. The big one.

zevara_bounty_paid.speaker: Zevara
zevara_bounty_paid.text: Signed. Mind the ink, it's still wet.

summons._comment: GH#334 note 4b: Act II pacing fires this, so it told cistern-innocent players 'You've been down there'. text_variants cannot express absence, so the base assumes none.
summons.speaker: Zevara
summons.text: There you are. A crew opening the grates under the market broke through into tunnels nobody dug. They go down, and they keep going. Olesm's maps say they shouldn't exist. I need somebody who isn't Watch to go and look. That's you.

text_variants.text: There you are. The cisterns crew found something under the new grates: tunnels nobody dug, going down past where their lanterns reached. Olesm's maps say they shouldn't exist. You've been down there. You're going again, this time for the Watch.

options.text: Give me a day to ready myself.

summons_send.speaker: Zevara
summons_send.text: Good. See Olesm before you climb down. He's been up since the second bell drawing what shouldn't be there, and he'll want you carrying it. And take Relc. That's an order.

seal.speaker: Zevara
seal.text: Gone? Good. Dead? Better. The Watch is bricking that gallery before sundown — 'for now,' before you say it. Things under Liscor have a way of minding being sealed. The masons are already stacking brick, and they'll want the street clear. Good work. I mean it.

shift.speaker: Zevara
shift.text: Ten years of long shifts. Six weeks of leave across all of them. Do the arithmetic and then don't ask why I look like this. My Senior Guardsmen are a spearmaster who won't stop talking and an Antinium I've heard maybe a dozen sentences from in two years. The wall stands. Ten years, no breach. I count that every morning, before the rosters.

options.text: The guard on the gate speaks well of you.
I'll let you get back to it.

authority.speaker: Zevara
authority.text: He should. I signed his posting and I read his reports — both of them, the real one and the one where nothing happened. That's Liscor's Watch as I intend it: boring gates, boring reports. I've read the other kind of report. There's a stack of them in my office a hand high.

sweep_pitch.speaker: Zevara
sweep_pitch.text: Sweep the cisterns. You know what a sweep costs? Six Watchmen off the wall, lanterns, a healer on standby, and a form in triplicate explaining to the Council why the wall was six thin. Give me one reason worth the ink.

options.text: If it's under the city and moving, it's Watch business before it becomes an emergency. File the form after.

sweep_argue.speaker: Zevara
sweep_argue.text: Before it's an emergency. Hm. You argue like someone who's read a casualty report. Fine. Make it plain. What am I actually sending them into?

options.text: A nest. Silver-backed spiders, up from the Dungeon. [Charming Smile]
Here — three gold for the lanterns and the healer. Budget problem solved, at least. (3 gold)

swept.speaker: Zevara
swept.text: Spiders from the Dungeon. Wonderful. A nest that size costs me six Watchmen and a night of overtime. Consider it swept. I'll pull a squad at dusk and burn the silk out before it spreads. You did right bringing it to me clean, before it had teeth. And good work. Now go tell whoever set you on this that the Watch has it.

swept_paid.speaker: Zevara
swept_paid.text: Funding, not evidence. Fine — my ledger doesn't much care which. I'll pull a squad at dusk and burn the silk out, whatever's actually down there. Set the coin on the desk. It goes down as lanterns and a healer.

cisterns_recap.speaker: Zevara
cisterns_recap.text: Whatever's nested in the cisterns under the market is still down there, last I heard. Same grate, south of here.

text_variants.text: It's cleared, is it? Then go tell Olesm at the Guild — he's the one keeping the tally.
